sloka: प्रत्युवाच ततो रामम् प्रांजलिर् वानरेश्वरः ।यत् त्वम् आत्थ नरश्रेष्ठ तत् थथा एव न अत्र संशयः ॥४-१८-४५॥
transliteration: pratyuvāca tato rāmam prāṁjalir vānareśvaraḥ ।yat tvam āttha naraśreṣṭha tat thathā eva na atra saṁśayaḥ ॥4-18-45॥

translations.english: Vali was very much pained to hear Rama. He became free from confusion regarding dharma and no longer found fault with Rama.
